page.layout: One page of text: running head at top; main text in one block; no marginal notes beyond the right and left edges of the poems (none legible as separate notes).

main_text.head: IN POMPILIVM gibbosum, diserti Poetæ nomen affectantem.

p.i: Errat Pompilium quisquis negat esse poetam, Et omnium quidem optimum.
Pompilium gibbo duplici, nugisque canoris Notum ἀμφίκυρτον omnibus.
Nam reliquis satis est, Parnassi in limine Musa Si vel salutent eminus:
Atqui Pompilius Parnassum hinc inde bicornem Totum ferens obambulat.

main_text.head: IN ZOILVM.
main_text.p: Zoile, non cessas nostrum damnare libellum, Errores solitus connumerare meos, Vt mala sint, at non sunt pessima carmina, quorum Zoilus errores enumerare potest.
main_text.head: Εἰς Ἕρμιλλον ἰατρομόναχον.
main_text.p: Ἀμμαρτὼν ποτ' ἰὼν μοναχὸν μιαρώτατος Ἑρμῆς, Εἰς ἰατρῶν παῖδας αὐτομολῶν ἀπέβης. Εὖ Γ' Ἑρμῆς γυναῖκα, μίαν μοναχός τ' ἰατρός τε Ἀσκληπιοῦ πίχλω, δὴς γὰρ ἀκροπομπὸς ἐών.
main_text.head: In eundem.

p.i: Vixisti monachus monachorum dedecus Hermes Nunc medicorum idem dedecus es medicus.

page.notes: Greek verses are transcribed as best legible; the scan is blurred in places and some Greek accents may be inexact.
